column1: # Simplified Chinese (zh-Hans) interface catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:
#   context    usually empty. `preview` is short sample text inside a rendered preview tile;
#              `template` is a built-in template's name in File > New.
#              Both fall back to the plain entry.
#   source     the English text exactly as in the code (tl!(...), ribbon labels, command labels)
#   escapes    \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns, and a
#              trailing "…" in one needs one in the other.
#   Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. A missing entry shows in English.
# Clean room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label in ordinary
# Simplified Chinese computing and typography vocabulary. No Microsoft PowerPoint (or other product)
# localisation, string table or translated UI was consulted or copied; add entries the same way.
# Where a string is identical to one WordCraft ships, WordCraft's zh-hans.tsv wording is reused, so
# the Crafting Apps read the same. Product, format and technology names (DeckCraft, PowerPoint,
# PDF, PPTX …) stay in Latin letters.
